description: This GitHub repository publishes sample solar-energy information and clear-sky indices from a parametric forecasting model for central and northern Mozambique. The dataset author supplies ten location-labelled CSV files, including Chiputo, Choa, Lugela, Massangulo and Nanhupo sites. The repository was updated in November 2024 and is freely accessible. Although GitHub has no separate licence file, the associated Data article explicitly assigns CC BY 4.0 to the dataset. These regional inputs and model-derived indices can calibrate PV resource and generation simulations. The repository lacks a README and does not establish full temporal coverage, which limits interpretation without the article. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Mozambique parametric solar-energy forecasting data and code
